''See also: [[Tomb Hydra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Tomb]] [[Sandborn Hydra|Hydra]] is a formidable guardian located within a spherical, honeycomb-like chamber filled with numerous tunnels. Described as being comparable to a baby [[Dreadgod]], this entity possesses power so immense that it can strike fear into even a [[Sage]]. Physically, the creature is massive and possesses three heads with glowing green eyes; however, it has been observed that multiple hydras can exist in the same area, with others emerging from bulbous sacs or dropping from the ceiling. Its internal anatomy features a parasitic [[madra]] system, and it is capable of generating semi-transparent barriers. Upon its defeat, the creature can leave behind a [[binding]] that manifests as a large, spectral green object resembling a human heart. The creature's presence is associated with [[death-madra|death madra]] and an environment composed of vast amounts of flesh.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|This creature emerged from a slick, bulbous sac located in an upper chamber. It is characterized by a beating, throbbing heart-shaped [[binding]] and has left much of the floor covered in its [[blood]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|As a guardian, this baby [[Dreadgod]] possesses enough power to cause a [[Sage]] to tremble in fear.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Tomb]] [[Sandborn Hydra|Hydra]] is a dreadbeasts{{!}}dreadbeast that utilizes a parasitic [[madra]] system.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Tomb]] [[Sandborn Hydra|Hydra]] is a powerful guardian described as a baby [[Dreadgod]] that possesses the strength to make even a [[Sage]] tremble. This [[dreadbeasts|dreadbeast]], which utilizes a parasitic [[madra]] system, was discovered within a honeycomb-like room where its [[blood]] coated much of the floor. During an examination of its [[binding]], a creature emerged from a slick bulbous sac located in the upper chamber. This [[binding]] is characterized by its beating, throbbing, heart-shaped form.}}
